dimensions.assessment: Directly impacts firefighters, paramedics, emergency medical services personnel, and local child care providers.
dimensions.evidence: child care services for the minor children of emergency services personnel during the shift work

dimensions.assessment: Provides significant financial and operational assistance for child care startup, renovation, and tuition costs.
dimensions.evidence: assistance for the startup costs... payment of expenses for operation, construction, or renovation

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $30 million annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2031, totaling $150 million.
dimensions.evidence: authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section, $30,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a competitive grant pilot program, matching requirements, mandatory studies, and reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: establish a program to award grants to lead agencies... establish a grant pilot program

dimensions.assessment: Operates as a temporary pilot program authorizing appropriations through fiscal year 2031 and terminating on September 30, 2031.
dimensions.evidence: program established under this section shall terminate on September 30, 2031

importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a 3-year grant pilot program authorized at $30 million annually through fiscal year 2031 to provide child care services for emergency services personnel with nontraditional work hours.
